dimensions.evidence: submit to the appropriate congressional committees a report that... includes a plan for providing... the staffing necessary

Requires a specific study, interagency reporting, and staffing plan focused exclusively on broadband land use authorizations on public lands.
dimensions.evidence: study to determine... if there are programmatic or administrative barriers to the timely review

dimensions.assessment: Primarily a one-time study and reporting requirement due within one year of enactment.

importance_detail.rationale: The bill mandates that the Department of the Interior and the Forest Service conduct studies, submit a report within one year, and formulate a staffing plan regarding broadband land use authorizations.
